# XTSY Travel

> XTSY is the biggest travellers' hostel in Shillong, Meghalaya (Northeast India) — budget dorms from ₹329/night, a luxury 270° panoramic glass suite, and curated Meghalaya & Northeast India tour packages. All XTSY stays are in Shillong; tours and experiences extend across Meghalaya, Northeast India, and Sikkim via a trusted partner network. Book direct for the best rates. Phone/WhatsApp: +91 8837317070.
